name: Zoshigaya
tagline: Shinjuku in 15 minutes and Shibuya in 16 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 15 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 28.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 28.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 24.3 m to 31.7 m, a difference of 7.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 肉のハナマサ 池袋店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 芳精会ぬかりや病院, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 大同病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line run through it. Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) also call here. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is not on. Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Zoshigaya, but Gakushuinshita is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Zoshigaya. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Zoshigaya. One-room rents run about ¥12,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Toden-Zoshigaya is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Zoshigaya is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Zoshigaya. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Zoshigaya.

noiseSources: 明治通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
